logger.doc:name: Before hr db
logger.message: #[%dw 2.0 output application/json import * from dw::util::Values --- { "applicationName": app.name, "flowName": flow.name, "source": "hr-app", "destination": "Database", "tansactionId": vars.headers.transactionId, "employeeId": attributes.uriParams.empId, "startTime": vars.startTime, "tracePoint": "START", "message": "updating of hr employees flow initialised" }]

db:update.doc:name: Updating the employee details
db:update.db:sql: update EMPLOYEE_INFO set emp_name = COALESCE(:empName, emp_name), emp_salary = COALESCE(:empSalary, emp_salary), emp_status = COALESCE(:empStatus, emp_status), emp_designation = COALESCE(:empDesignation, emp_designation) where emp_id = :empId;
db:update.db:input-parameters: #[{ empId: attributes.uriParams.empId, empName: payload.empName default null, empSalary: payload.empSalary default null, empDesignation: payload.empDesignation default null, empStatus: if (payload.active) "Active" else "Inactive" }]

logger.doc:name: After hr db
logger.message: #[%dw 2.0 output application/json import * from dw::util::Values --- { "applicationName": app.name, "flowName": flow.name, "source": "hr-app", "destination": "Database", "tansactionId": vars.headers.transactionId, "employeeId": vars.empId, "startTime": vars.startTime, "tracePoint": "START", "message": "deleting of hr employees flow completed" }]

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { empId: vars.empId, statusCode: 200, message: 'success' }
